summary: The red-box urgent logic is largely correct, but the non-urgent flowchart is incomplete: there is no Inflammatory back pain likely rule, and the mechanical back pain rule has a likely reversed 6-week onset comparison and omits age, exercise and rest criteria. Complicated and uncomplicated pyelonephritis collapse to the same concept, and the injury criterion lacks recency and x-ray conditions.
